name: Ramp
text:
Use a 2px solid #005fcc ring with no inner ring for focus indicators. This keeps the focus ring visible on all backgrounds, including high-contrast patterns, while still meeting WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements. The trade-off is a slightly less "bold" ring, but that’s acceptable because visibility is the priority. Test it on a zebra-striped background to confirm it works everywhere.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks failing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the white inner ring vanishes. A 2px solid #005fcc ring alone meets WCAG 2.2 AA without the inner ring and avoids the pattern clash. Test it on a zebra-striped background to settle the argument.
